root |_>lion.png |_>tiger.png |->Alpha |_>cat.png |_>dog.png |->Beta |_>monkey.png |_>panda.png |->photos |_>photo1.png |_>photo2.png To go from lion.png to photo1.png, the relative path would be: Alpha/Beta/photos/photo1.png To go from tiger.png to panda.png, the relative path would be: Alpha/Beta/panda.png //To go down we use / and to go up we use ../ To go from cat.png to tiger.png, the relative path would be: ../tiger.png To go from panda.png to tiger.png, the relative path would be: ../../tiger.png
